Question: Two men at points \(R\) and \(S,\) \(76\) miles apart, set out at the same time to walk towards each other. The man at \(R\) walks uniformly at \(4\dfrac12\) miles per hour; the man at \(S\) walks at \(3\dfrac14\) miles per hour for the first hour, at \(3\dfrac34\) miles per hour for the second hour, and so on, in arithmetic progression. If the men meet \(x\) miles nearer \(R\) than \(S\) in an integral number of hours, then \(x\) is:
